fields.label: Type
fields.description: Mailbox: a real mailbox with its own Email Account; replies to its mail go out from it. Group: a group or alias without a mailbox of its own.

fields.label: Collected by
fields.description: The Email Account that brings this address's mail into CRM; staff mailboxes then leave it alone. Required for a mailbox. Left empty for a group, every staff mailbox that gets the mail keeps one copy.

fields.label: New leads
fields.description: Pool: a new lead has no owner until someone replies to it from CRM. Round robin: CRM's own Assignment Rule on leads picks the owner.
